design.name: dual_clock
design.notes: Two independent clock/reset domains; the synchronizer is a two-flop synchronizer.

requirements.reason: The domain A reset value is a state invariant checked on the clk_a reset domain.

evidence.quote: While rst_a_n is low, dbg_req_a shall be 0.

requirements.reason: The capture transition is a next-cycle relation in the clk_a domain.

evidence.quote: When i_req is 1 and dbg_req_a is 0, dbg_req_a shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_a.

requirements.reason: The domain B reset value is a state invariant checked on the clk_b reset domain.

evidence.quote: While rst_b_n is low, o_ack shall be 0.

requirements.reason: The acknowledge transition is a next-cycle relation in the clk_b domain.

evidence.quote: When the synchronized request dbg_req_b_sync is 1 and o_ack is 0, o_ack shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_b.

requirements.reason: The reachability scenario is checked by a cover property in the clk_b domain.

evidence.quote: A cycle with dbg_req_b_sync 1 and o_ack 1 shall be reachable after reset in domain B.

properties.title: Domain A reset clears the captured request

evidence.quote: While rst_a_n is low, dbg_req_a shall be 0.

properties.title: Domain A captures a request on the next clock edge

evidence.quote: When i_req is 1 and dbg_req_a is 0, dbg_req_a shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_a.

properties.title: Domain B reset clears the acknowledge

evidence.quote: While rst_b_n is low, o_ack shall be 0.

properties.title: Domain B acknowledges a synchronized request

evidence.quote: When the synchronized request dbg_req_b_sync is 1 and o_ack is 0, o_ack shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_b.
A cycle with dbg_req_b_sync 1 and o_ack 1 shall be reachable after reset in domain B.

proven: BMC and induction per property, with each property bound to its declared clock/reset domain
not_proven: Metastability, MTBF and analog CDC effects are out of scope
The two-flop synchronizer is a logical model only
scope.notes: Dual-clock fixture for per-property clock/reset and domain resolution.
